description: This file contains unit tests for the ParameterOptionVisitor class, testing its handling of search options such as limit, sort, cursor, and size within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It uses Mockito for mocking dependencies.

classes.name: ParameterOptionVisitorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing ParameterOptionVisitor's behavior with various search options.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up common mock objects and test fixtures before each test method runs.

methods.name: constructorWithNullExpressionFactory
methods.description: Ensures constructor throws NullPointerException if expression factory is null.

methods.name: constructorWithNullQueryBuilder
methods.description: Ensures constructor throws NullPointerException if query builder is null.

methods.name: visitLimitOption
methods.description: Tests that visiting a limit option sets skip and limit on the query builder.

methods.name: visitSortOptionWithSingleSortOption
methods.description: Tests sorting with a single sort option and verifies the expression factory and query builder interactions.

methods.name: visitUnsupportedSortExpression
methods.description: Checks that an unsupported sort expression throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: visitSortOptionMultiple
methods.description: Verifies multiple sort options are handled correctly and added to the query builder.

methods.name: visitLimitOptionAndSortOption
methods.description: Tests combined handling of limit and sort options in one visit.

methods.name: visitCursorAndSizeOptions
methods.description: Verifies cursor and size options are properly processed.
